verdict.rationale: Claude Design documents granting edit access so colleagues can modify a design and work with Claude together in a group conversation, which is a first-party form of shared team editing. Nothing shows true simultaneous multiplayer editing. Missing for 10: evidence of simultaneous concurrent editing, live cursors/presence indicators, instant real-time sync, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multiplayer collaboration.

support.subject: As a designer, my whole team can edit the same file simultaneously with live cursors and instant sync

citations.quote: grant edit access so colleagues can modify the design and chat with Claude together in a group conversation
